name: cineverso
description: O CineVerso é um sistema web desenvolvido para a disciplina de Programação IV.

scripts.setup: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && npm run prisma:generate
scripts.local: docker compose up -d && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names BACKEND,FRONTEND,BROWSER --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "cd backend && npm run start:dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && open-cli http://localhost:3000"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm run build
scripts.lint: cd frontend && npm run lint && cd ../backend && npm run lint
